ff_captain_1.m: Are you lost, son? This is no place for a kid like you.
r: I have a shipment of iron swords from Gandoren for you.
I have a shipment of iron swords from Gandoren for you.
Have you seen a boy called Rincel around here recently?
Hi! I have been sent by Herg ... Hertzsen Laumwill, patriarch of the Laumwill family, to bring back his daughter!
Let's talk about the beer investigation.

ff_captain_2.m: I am the guard captain of this patrol. We hail from the great city of Feygard.
r: What do you do around here?

ff_captain_3.m: We are travelling the main road to make sure the merchants and travelers are safe. We keep the peace around here.
r: You mentioned Feygard. Where is that?
So when you say "peace", you really mean "law enforcement"?

ff_captain_4.m: The great city of Feygard is the greatest sight you will ever see. Follow the road northwest.
r: Thank you. Shadow be with you.

ff_captain_beer_10.m: You got it, kid, we watch out for lawbreakers!
r: I knew it! Do you have your eye on anyone right now?
There's nothing to look at here. [You slowly back up and end the conversation.]

ff_captain_beer_100.m: Great to hear. I need you to talk with the tavern owner and find out anything you can about the beer.

ff_captain_beer_110.m: Well, because I am a Feygard captain and as such, the tavern keep will never give me information.

ff_captain_beer_111.m: Great. Report back to me when you have learnt something useful.

ff_captain_beer_120.m: Sullengard? Of course! Get down there now kid and get me more information.
r: Yes, sir. Anything for the glorious Feygard.
I'll go to Sullengard when I feel like it. You don't own me.
Watch it captain! I am not one of your soldiers.

ff_captain_beer_20.m: You bet I have. I suspect we are witnessing one right now.
r: Really?! Who is it? Can I help?
Oh, sorry, but this sounds exciting.

ff_captain_beer_40.m: Well, if you look around this tavern, both inside and outside, do you notice anything?

r: Now you are the one that needs to lower his voice.

ff_captain_beer_60.m: There is a large amount of beer here. There are a number of beer barrels outside. Both full and empty ones. There is a lot inside as well. Too much in fact!
r: OK...Why does this equal a law being broken?

ff_captain_beer_70.m: Well, for starters, Feygard taxes all beer sales. It is one of the best sources of gold used by Feygard to provide protection for the cities and towns.
r: Understood, but I am still not seeing how this means that a law has been broken.

ff_captain_beer_80.m: Well, you see kid, I used to work in the 'tax collection' division of the Feygard patrol and I don't ever remember seeing the kind of collected taxes that would reflect this kind of volume of beer.
r: Um...I think I might be catching up to what you are thinking. Please, continue

ff_captain_beer_90.m: That's pretty much it kid, but I need your help.
r: OK, but only if there is something in it for me.
No, thanks. I'm out of here.

ff_captain_beer_tell.m: WHAT?! Tell me what you know, now!
r: That's the thing, I don't 'know' anything that I could prove.

ff_captain_beer_tell_10.m: I knew that you would be a waste of my time. I'll reward you with nothing.
r: I should get going. Sorry that I could not be more helpful.

ff_captain_beer_tell_everything_10.m: I knew that I could count on you kid. Please enlighten me and I will reward you handsomely.
r: What would you like to know first?
It is coming from a town south of here called Sullengard.

ff_captain_beer_tell_everything_30.m: Sullengard?! Of course it would be coming from Sullengard.

ff_captain_beer_tell_everything_32.m: What else can you tell me?
r: I know that the Thieves' Guild are the ones helping the people of Sullengard distribute their beer.

ff_captain_beer_tell_everything_33.m: The Thieves' Guild? Are you sure?
r: Oh yeah. I heard it directly from them.

ff_captain_beer_tell_everything_40.m: Well done kid. Here, take some gold.
r: All that work, and the reward is just gold?

ff_captain_beer_tell_everything_50.m: Hey, what do you want from me? I'm stuck here babysitting a bunch of drunk guards.

ff_captain_beer_tell_everything_60.m: Anyways, I'd like you to know that as soon as I can get word back to Feygard, we will be putting an end to their beer bootlegging operation.

ff_captain_beer_tell_sull.m: That is disappointing, but at least you know something. Tell me.

ff_captain_beer_tell_sull_10.m: The Thieves' Guild? Are you sure?
r: Oh yeah. I heard it directly from them.

ff_captain_beer_tell_sull_20.m: Well done kid. Here, take some gold.
r: Thanks and Shadow be with you.

ff_captain_beer_tell_sull_30.m: I'd like you to know that as soon as I can get word back to Feygard, we will be putting an end to their beer bootlegging operation.

ff_captain_beer_tell_thieves.m: That is disappointing, but at least you know something. Please tell me.
r: The brewers are the families of Sullengard.

ff_captain_beer_tell_thieves_10.m: Sullengard?! Of course it would be coming from Sullengard. I should have known it is coming from them.

ff_captain_beer_tell_thieves_11.m: Well done kid. Here, take some gold.

ff_captain_beer_tell_thieves_20.m: I'd like you to know that as soon as I can get word back to Feygard, we will be putting an end to their beer bootlegging operation.

ff_captain_guild02_1.m: What? I haven't been informed of that. Since you seem like an inexperienced kid, I don't believe you.
r: Ergh ... Mr Laumwill is grateful for your protection. However ... Ah! He has given this reward of {1000} gold for your efforts.
Trust me, I'm the one that delivered those swords from Gandoren to you!
(I would like to bribe the captain, but I need at least {1000} Gold) I will come back later.

ff_captain_guild02_2a.m: Oh! What a considerable reward! OK, OK. Only Feygard people are so generous!

ff_captain_guild02_2b.m: Oh, I see. Maybe you're right.

ff_captain_guild02_3.m: I have to stay here to supervise my guards. They sometimes need educating about what to do. I assume you're able to escort her without problems?
r: [Lie]For the glory of Feygard, I will!

ff_captain_hurry_up.m: Then why are you wasting your and my time by coming back here? Get going.

ff_captain_items_1.m: Excellent, I have been waiting for these. Thank you for bringing them to me.

ff_captain_rincel_1.m: There was a kid running around in here a while ago.

ff_captain_rincel_2.m: I never talked to him though, so I don't know if he is the one you are looking for.
r: OK, that might be something worth checking anyway.

ff_captain_rincel_3.m: I noticed he left to the west heading out of the Foaming Flask tavern.
r: West. Got it. Thanks for the information.

ff_captain_rincel_4.m: Always happy to help. Anything for the glory of Feygard.

ff_captain_selector.m: Have you learned anything about the beer?
r: A little bit, but I need to go find out more.
I've talked to a couple of tavern owners, learned a few things, but I need to talk to some more people
I've learned a lot, but I am still not ready to give you my report.
All the information I have obtained points me to Sullengard.
I still have some investigation to conduct in Sullengard. I will return to you afterwards.
I still have some investigation to conduct in Sullengard. I will return to you afterwards.
I've learned everything that you will care to know about the beer bootlegging operation.
I know who is distributing the beer, but not the source of the beer.
I know where the beer is coming from, but I do not know who is distributing it.
I am sorry, but I have learned nothing that I am willing to share or feel confident in sharing with you.

ff_captain_shadow_1.m: The Shadow? Don't tell me you believe in that stuff. In my experience, only troublemakers talk of the Shadow.

Thieves02.2: After completing my first task I'm considered a member of Thieves' Guild. Now I have to perform a very risky task. Umar sent me to kidnap a noble woman from Feygard, without being discovered.
Thieves02.4: She was recently seen in the Foaming Flask tavern.
Thieves02.6: Umar gave me some advice. My strength is not always the solution. I must "use my tongue" to avoid raising suspicion in the tavern.
Thieves02.10: Ambelie Laumwill doesn't want to come with me peacefully. I cannot make a scene, or the guards will alert other patrols. Maybe talking with them would solve the situation.
Thieves02.15: I have "used my tongue" with the main Feygard soldier in the Foaming Flask tavern. He gave me permission to "escort back" Ambelie.
Thieves02.20: I knocked out Ambelie. I will take her back to the Guild.
Thieves02.21: I have decided not to kidnap Ambelie. I must think of another solution.
Thieves02.24: Ambelie gave me a very valuable necklace. I must talk with Umar and persuade him to no longer pursue her.
Thieves02.30: I safely brought Ambelie to the basement. However, keeping her here could be dangerous.
Thieves02.35: Umar believes there is a secure room for these types of "visitors". I should talk to Troublemaker.
Thieves02.40: I have talked to Troublemaker about the place Umar believes it's okay to safely keep the hostage.
Thieves02.45: Troublemaker has given me the key to the Guild brig. I should take Ambelie there and leave her to wake up.
Thieves02.50: I've inserted the key and moved the lever. A hatchway has opened in the room.
Thieves02.55: I left Ambelie in that ugly, dark, and cold place. I should go back.
Thieves02.60: Troublemaker gave me some bread for Ambelie. The guild doesn't want her to starve to death. Indeed, they want her to be as comfortable as possible. I must go to the brig again.
Thieves02.65: I gave the bread to Ambelie. I should report Troublemaker that I completed the job.
Thieves02.70: The job finally seems to be finished. I just have to talk with Umar again. However, I do not feel good about this. Kidnappings are definitely not my kind of job.
Thieves02.75: I completed this task successfully. Umar told me they have sent couriers to Feygard, and the ransom is almost guaranteed. He paid me for my work.
Thieves02.76: Umar took the necklace as compensation for my errors. Everything is fine again.

feygard_shipment.10: I met Gandoren, the guard captain at the Crossroads guardhouse. He told me about some trouble up in Loneford, that have forced the guards to be even more alert than usual. Because of this, they can't do their regular errands themselves but need help with some basic things.
feygard_shipment.20: Gandoren wants me to help him transport a shipment of 10 iron swords to another guard post to the south.
feygard_shipment.21: I have agreed to help Gandoren transport the shipment, as a service for Feygard.
feygard_shipment.22: I have grudgingly agreed to help Gandoren transport the shipment.
feygard_shipment.25: I should deliver the shipment to the Feygard patrol captain stationed in the Foaming Flask tavern.
feygard_shipment.26: Gandoren tells me that Ailshara has expressed some interest in the Feygard shipments, and urges me to stay away from her.
feygard_shipment.30: Ailshara is indeed interested in the shipment, and wants me to help Nor City with the supplies instead.
feygard_shipment.35: If I want to help Ailshara and Nor City, I should deliver the shipment to the smith in Vilegard instead.
feygard_shipment.50: I have delivered the shipment to the Feygard patrol captain in the Foaming Flask tavern. I should go tell Gandoren in the Crossroads guardhouse that the shipment is delivered.
feygard_shipment.55: I have delivered the shipment to the smith in Vilegard.
feygard_shipment.56: The Vilegard smith gave me a shipment of degraded items that I should deliver to the Feygard patrol captain in the Foaming Flask tavern instead of the normal ones.
feygard_shipment.60: I have delivered the shipment of degraded items to the Feygard patrol captain in the Foaming Flask tavern. I should go tell Gandoren in the Crossroads guardhouse that the shipment is delivered.
feygard_shipment.80: Gandoren thanked me for helping him deliver the shipment.
feygard_shipment.81: Gandoren thanked me for helping him deliver the shipment. He never suspected anything. I should also report back to Ailshara.
feygard_shipment.82: I have reported back to Ailshara.

beer_bootlegging.10: I've agreed to help the Feygard patrol captain investigate why there is so much beer on the Foaming flask tavern property.
beer_bootlegging.20: After bribing Torilo, the owner of the Foaming flask, he stated that he and other tavern owners had a 'business agreement' with a group of 'distributors'. He suggested that I ask other tavern owners for more information.
beer_bootlegging.30: After bribing Tharwyn, the owner of the Vilegard tavern, he stated as part of his 'business agreement', Dunla, the local thief, is one of his 'distributors'. He suggested that I talk to him.
beer_bootlegging.40: Dunla, the thief in Vilegard instructed me to speak with Farrick if I want to learn more about the tavern owner's 'business agreement' with their 'distributors'.
beer_bootlegging.50: Farrik told me that the beer is coming from Sullengard. I really should go there next.
beer_bootlegging.60: To earn his trust, Mayor Ale has asked that I deliver his letter to Kealwea, the Sullengard priest.
beer_bootlegging.70: I have done what Mayor Ale has asked of me as I have delivered his letter. I should now return to him.
beer_bootlegging.80: Mayor Ale has explained everything to me about the 'business agreement' with the Thieves guild. I should head back to the Foaming flask tavern and speak with the captain.
beer_bootlegging.90: I informed the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern all about the beer bootlegging operation.
beer_bootlegging.100: I informed the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern that the beer was being distributed by the Thieves guild.
beer_bootlegging.110: I informed the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern that Sullengard was responsible for brewing the beer.
beer_bootlegging.120: I lied to the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern and told him nothing about the beer bootlegging operation.

wrye.10: Jolnor in Vilegard chapel wants me to talk to Wrye in northern Vilegard. She has apparently lost her son recently.
wrye.20: Wrye in northern Vilegard tells me that her son Rincel has gone missing. She thinks that he has died or gotten critically hurt.
wrye.30: Wrye tells me that she thinks the royal guard from Feygard are involved in his disappearance, and that they have recruited him.
wrye.40: Wrye wants me to go search for clues as to what has happened to her son.
wrye.41: I should go look in the Vilegard tavern and the Foaming Flask tavern north of Vilegard.
wrye.42: I heard of a boy being in the Foaming Flask tavern a while ago. Apparently he left to the west of the tavern somewhere.
wrye.80: To the northwest of Vilegard I found a man that had found Rincel fighting some monsters. Rincel had apparently left Vilegard by his own will to go see the city of Feygard. I should go tell Wrye in northern Vilegard what happened to her son.
wrye.90: I have told Wrye the truth about her son's disappearance.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
